newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in Shun Shing shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Shun Shing shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Shun Shing Holdings Ltd was suspended on Wednesday morning at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Shares of the construction and property development concern eased HK$0.05 to HK$5.85 before trading was suspended at 10.27 a.m. (0227 GMT).
Earlier this month, Shun Shing raised about HK$623.3 million in working capital through a placement and new share issue.
Prices of Shun Shing shares have risen sharply on buying fuelled by asset injection hopes after the COSCO (Hong Kong) Group made a general offer for Shun Shing shares in February.
The China-controlled group has a 61 percent stake in Shun Shing through its subsidiary COSCO (H.K.) Property Development Ltd.
